title: Elliott Runtime — Connection Graph (enriched)

note: Pure architectural connection graph: nodes (system components) and edges (how they connect). No visualization, layout, color, or feature metadata. Each node carries its source (file[:line]) and a factual `runtime` liveness flag. Each edge carries kind, protocol, a label, and the evidence (call site) that proves the connection. Awaiting enrichment (domains, classifications, contracts, routing). ENRICHMENT v2.0.0-enriched: added top-level `domains` (12), `classificationSchemes`, and `enrichmentNotes`; each node now carries `domain`, `classifications`, `interface`, and `characteristics`; each edge now carries `contract`, `routing`, `activation`, and `security`. The verified connection core (node id/kind/source/runtime, edge id/from/to/kind/protocol/label/evidence) is unchanged -- enrichment is strictly additive. runtimeLegend.live: active in the running production runtime
runtimeLegend.config-gated: wired, but only registers/activates when its secret or enabled flag resolves
runtimeLegend.dormant: exists in code (often the canonical framework layer) but is never instantiated or fed at runtime
runtimeLegend.declared: declared in deploy/compose config but not consumed by any runtime code path

domains.title: Secrets
domains.purpose: Deploy-time secret provenance: Vault (the configured secrets path) values rendered into container env and read by field name at boot.
domains.internalCommunication: Single node; no intra-domain traffic. Values are materialized once at boot by the config loader's SecretResolver.
domains.ingressContracts: None at runtime. At deploy time the deploy pipeline authenticates to Vault via AppRole and renders the configured secrets path into the container environment.
domains.egressContracts: Rendered strings flow OUT one-way into model-inference (llmApiKey -> Bearer; llmBaseUrl is a non-secret config literal, elliott.yaml:16), observability (glitchtip.dsn), external-integrations (brave/firecrawl/parallel/gmail/bluebubbles/smtp/ssh keys), deployment-substrate (browser_token) via ${VAULT:path#field} config expressions.
domains.routing: config.ts resolveExpression() matches ${VAULT:path#field}/${ENV:name} and calls SecretResolver.vault/env; the runtime resolver reads the vault-rendered value from process.env by field name.
domains.failureIsolation: Per-secret best-effort resolution: an unresolvable config/secrets.yaml entry is dropped so the owning skill stays unregistered, while a missing required core value throws and aborts boot.

domains.title: Ingress & Front Controller
domains.purpose: The untrusted edge: receive inbound messages (Slack Socket Mode, HMAC webhook), dispatch HTTP routes, dedup, single-flight, and admit work as turns.
domains.internalCommunication: In-process callbacks. Gateways invoke the shared GatewayEvents.onMessage/onFeedback closures; the HTTP server dispatches RouteBindings by exact method+path; all funnel into #handleInbound.
domains.ingressContracts: External-untrusted: Slack events over a Socket Mode WebSocket (owner-only gate) and POST /v1/gateways/webhook (HMAC-SHA256 verified). InboundMessage is the normalized shape.
domains.egressContracts: control -> agent-core (agent.turn); persist -> memory-persistence (snapshot pin, evidence beginTurn, feedback); control -> observability (telemetry emit, error capture).
domains.routing: SlackGateway frame router -> events.onMessage; Bun.serve fetch -> #handleRequest exact-match route table; #handleInbound builds the per-turn observer and calls the agent.
domains.dataClassification: untrusted-external (message text/attachments); owner-pii (live Slack thread history)
domains.failureIsolation: message.id dedup (#seen), per-conversation single-flight (#inflight busy reply), per-turn try/catch -> evidence failure + telemetry + error report + user apology; gateway connect errors retried with backoff.

domains.title: Agent Core
domains.purpose: The trusted reasoning core: the bounded round loop, prompt assembly with the untrusted-evidence security contract, and parallel tool dispatch.
domains.internalCommunication: Direct in-process method calls inside RuntimeAgent.turn: #systemPrompt() assembles the request each round; Promise.all(#execute) fans out tool calls; results reassembled into messages.
domains.ingressContracts: control -> agent.turn(conversation, text, {observer, context, retainHistory}) from ingress.
domains.egressContracts: data -> model-inference (ModelTurnRequest); data -> tool-execution/external-integrations/mcp-federation (ToolDefinition.execute); persist -> memory-persistence (evidence via threaded observer); control -> observability (tool.progress).
domains.routing: MAX_ROUNDS=8 loop; ReadonlyMap<string,ToolDefinition> name lookup for dispatch; final round forces allowTools=false.
domains.failureIsolation: #execute never throws (errors become tool messages); tool output truncated to 30000 chars and wrapped [UNTRUSTED TOOL OUTPUT]; per-conversation persona/tool pinning isolates in-flight sessions from evolution promotions.

domains.title: Model Inference
domains.purpose: Route attestation and the OpenAI-compatible completion call to the LiteLLM gateway; the only model egress path.
domains.internalCommunication: In-process: RuntimeModelClient.complete() calls #attest() as a synchronous internal step to stamp a routeDigest; the provider is reached by fetch.
domains.ingressContracts: data <- agent-core (ModelTurnRequest); secret <- secrets (Bearer key + base URL).
domains.egressContracts: http -> provider.litellm (POST /v1/chat/completions, Bearer); control -> agent-core (RuntimeModelSelection); persist -> memory-persistence (model_selections); control -> observability (model.request/model.selection).
domains.routing: No dynamic selection: #attest hashes a FIXED {baseUrl, model} into routeDigest; the request is always POSTed to the single configured LiteLLM base URL with the single configured model id.
domains.failureIsolation: Non-2xx from LiteLLM throws 'LiteLLM <status>: <detail<=500>' which bubbles to the turn catch and a user apology; no retry. provider.ollama is dormant (never constructed).

domains.title: Sandboxed Local Tool Execution
domains.purpose: First-party capability tools that act on the local workspace, host processes, allowlisted SSH hosts, or the file-backed reminder store.
domains.internalCommunication: None between tools; each is an independent ToolDefinition dispatched by runtime.toolExec. The scheduler additionally runs its own 30s poll service.
domains.ingressContracts: data <- agent-core (ToolDefinition.execute with parsed JSON args).
domains.egressContracts: Local side effects: workspace file IO, argv-only process spawn, ssh to allowlisted hosts. service.scheduler also emits data -> ingress (outbound reminder delivery via primaryGateway.send).
domains.routing: runtime.toolExec map lookup by tool name; scheduler tick via setInterval filters due reminders and calls context.deliver.
domains.dataClassification: user-content (workspace files, reminder text); internal; secret (materialized ssh key)
domains.failureIsolation: Path containment rejects escapes (files); command allowlist + minimal PATH + 60s kill (terminal); host allowlist + BatchMode + 0600 key (ssh); scheduler tick errors reported, delivery needs a send-capable gateway.

domains.title: External Integrations
domains.purpose: Tools that reach services outside the process over the network: public-web readers and the owner's personal accounts/devices with real-world side effects.
domains.internalCommunication: None between tools; each is an independent ToolDefinition. browser routes through the companion daemon; the rest fetch third-party HTTP APIs.
domains.egressContracts: http/https -> third-party services (Brave/DDG/Firecrawl/Parallel, Gmail API, SMTP, BlueBubbles, Home Assistant REST); http -> deployment-substrate (browserless companion).
domains.routing: runtime.toolExec map lookup; each tool builds its own fetch/SMTP call with per-tool allowlists and API keys.
domains.dataClassification: untrusted-external (web/page content inbound); owner-pii (email/iMessage/home state outbound)
domains.failureIsolation: SSRF guard (publicUrl) + domain allowlists; recipient allowlists for send tools (email/imessage); entity/service regex validation (HA); config-gating so unconfigured integrations never register; each tool throw becomes a tool-message error.

domains.title: MCP Federation
domains.purpose: Federate remote MCP servers, exposing their tools as mcp_<id>_<tool> and bridging JSON-RPC over streamable-http (the external MCP server) and SSE (home-assistant).
domains.internalCommunication: mcp.client owns one RpcWire (ServiceBinding) per endpoint; wire.request('tools/call') marshals JSON-RPC to the remote server and correlates the response.
domains.ingressContracts: data <- agent-core (execute on an mcp_<id>_<tool> ToolDefinition).
domains.egressContracts: jsonrpc over streamable-http -> the configured MCP endpoint; jsonrpc over SSE -> mcp.homeassistant.
domains.routing: connectMcp selects wire by settings.transport; at boot: initialize -> notifications/initialized -> paged tools/list; per call: tools/call {name, arguments}.
domains.failureIsolation: Per-endpoint Promise.allSettled at boot: a failed endpoint is reported (mcp:<id>) and contributes no tools; SSE has a 60s per-request timeout and fails pending calls on stream close; JSON-RPC errors unwrap to thrown Errors.

domains.title: Memory
domains.purpose: Durable evidence and provenance: the sqlite session store (evolution tables), the digest-only evidence sink, immutable config snapshots, and the dormant curated memory.
domains.internalCommunication: In-process: the evidence sink is a narrow Pick of SessionEvolutionStore sharing the SessionStore's bun:sqlite handle; INSERT/UPDATE go to sessions.sqlite (WAL). Snapshots are an independent file store + in-memory per-conversation pin.
domains.ingressContracts: persist <- agent-core/model-inference/ingress (runs, tool_calls, component_uses, model_selections, feedback); control <- ingress/kernel-governance (snapshot pin / boot snapshot create).
domains.egressContracts: learn -> self-evolution (sqlite reads of feedback/tool-failure summaries); data -> observability (read-only sqlite tail by the map).
domains.routing: Evidence observer callbacks -> record* methods -> parameterized SQL; snapshot resolve() first-write-wins per conversation; content-addressed snapshot ids stamp every run.
domains.dataClassification: operational-metadata + digest-only (no raw prompt/args/tool output persisted)
domains.failureIsolation: Every evidence write is wrapped in a try/catch that reports and continues; a failed recordRun disables the turn's evidence without breaking the turn; WAL single-writer; the readonly tail tolerates a briefly-absent file.

domains.title: Darwin
domains.purpose: The governed, off-hot-path learning loop: detect regression signals from evidence, triage/score them, optimize+evaluate candidates, author proposals, and gate promotion via an operator control plane.
domains.internalCommunication: In-process Effect pipelines driven by the continuous scheduler tick: signals -> triage (top-scored) -> orchestrator scope/evaluate -> proposal author; the control plane and companions are reached over HTTP.
domains.ingressContracts: learn <- memory-persistence (evidence reads); control <- operator via POST /v1/control/evolution.
domains.egressContracts: http -> evaluator.companions (sealed OCI: dspy/darwinian/evaluator/canary); control -> memory-persistence/kernel-governance (snapshot promotion, audit records); data -> ingress (Slack notifications via notify).
domains.routing: Campaign gate (single-flight queue) + selectRuntimeEvolutionSignal + triageEvolutionSignals scoring; control-plane maps operation->capability and authorizes before executing; scheduler ticks every 30s.
domains.failureIsolation: Entire subsystem is config-gated (evolution config + evolutionRuntime + continuous.enabled) and inert otherwise; distinct scheduler principal with Proposal-only capabilities (approve/promote/rollback forbidden); unavailable engines/evaluators degrade to typed errors; budgets + concurrency caps + cooldowns.

domains.title: Observability
domains.purpose: The live operational-visibility surface: the in-process telemetry bus, the GlitchTip error reporter, and the telemetry-map extension (routes + SSE + read-only DB tail).
domains.internalCommunication: In-process pub/sub: core emits onto runtimeTelemetry; the map's Aggregator subscribes and re-emits db.write/heartbeat; the reporter is a standalone capture funnel.
domains.ingressContracts: control <- ingress/agent-core/model-inference (telemetry emit, error capture); data <- memory-persistence (readonly sqlite tail); data <- ingress HTTP (GET map routes); secret <- config (glitchtip.dsn to the glitchtip sink's POST target only; the neutral reporter holds no secret — it transmits a message-free TransmittableError, so nothing to redact).
domains.egressContracts: http -> GlitchTip (Sentry envelope, best-effort); SSE/JSON -> operator browser; in-process -> deployment-substrate (co-located skill).
domains.routing: bus.emit(type,payload,runId) fan-out to a subscriber set; exact method+path route dispatch for /v1/observability/map*; SqliteTail 1.5s poll.
domains.trustBoundary: edge (map GET routes are unauthenticated but loopback-published only)
domains.dataClassification: operational-metadata; digest-only; optionally prompt content in model.request events when ELLIOTT_TELEMETRY_PROMPTS!=0
domains.failureIsolation: Subscriber isolation: a throwing telemetry subscriber or dead SSE client is caught and never affects a turn; the reporter's send failures only console.error; the ring buffer (512) and map windows (400 events / 60 turns) bound memory.

domains.title: Kernel
domains.purpose: The AgentKernel lifecycle and the two governance ledgers it instantiates: the hash-chained/Merkle AuditLog (live for lifecycle + evolution) and the dormant FootprintTracker.
domains.internalCommunication: In-process: the kernel appends RecordDrafts to its AuditLog and constructs the FootprintTracker; both are members instantiated by the kernel constructor.
domains.ingressContracts: control <- boot (kernel.start); persist <- self-evolution (audit records for signals/releases).
domains.egressContracts: persist -> memory-persistence (kernel owns the FileSnapshotStore used to create the boot snapshot); records/epochs/snapshots handed to self-evolution.
domains.routing: kernel.start/stop append kernel.started/stopped + crossLink; audit shards chain by digest and cross-link into a Merkle root.
domains.failureIsolation: start() throws if already started; most sub-registries (registry/broker/dispatcher/placement/footprints/discovery) are dormant so cannot fail on the hot path; audit uses durability classes (effect-gating committed immediately, observational buffered to a 128 tail).

domains.title: Deployment Substrate
domains.purpose: The container topology: the hardened elliott app container, the declared-but-unread postgres, and the network-isolated browserless companion.
domains.internalCommunication: Docker Compose: elliott depends_on postgres (startup ordering only) and shares an isolated 'browser' network with agent-browser.
domains.egressContracts: tcp -> agent-browser (browser network); depends_on -> postgres; hosts the in-process runtime + bundled skills.
domains.dataClassification: internal; untrusted-external (rendered pages in the browser companion)
domains.failureIsolation: elliott: read-only rootfs, cap_drop ALL, no-new-privileges, tmpfs, non-root uid, restart unless-stopped, healthcheck retries; agent-browser isolated to the 'browser' network and token-gated; postgres is declared-only (no runtime reader).

trustZone.external-untrusted: Data/callers from outside the trust boundary (Slack events, webhook posts); never treated as instructions.
trustZone.edge: Boundary components that receive/dispatch untrusted input but run trusted code (HTTP server, front controller, unauthenticated-but-loopback map routes).
trustZone.trusted-core: In-process trusted runtime logic (turn loop, prompt, evidence, kernel, audit).
trustZone.sandboxed: Capability execution constrained by containment/allowlists/isolated networks (files/terminal/ssh, browser companion).
trustZone.egress: Outbound calls leaving the process to a provider/integration (LiteLLM, MCP, web APIs, GlitchTip, OCI companions).

criticality.path-critical: On the synchronous request path; its failure fails or degrades a user turn.
criticality.supporting: Live and exercised, but a turn can complete without it (tools, evidence, telemetry, reminders).
criticality.latent: Present but not exercised on the hot path (dormant/declared, or gated subsystems only active off-path).

statefulness.in-memory-state: Process-local mutable state lost on restart (dedup sets, ring buffer, caches, sockets).
statefulness.durable-state: State that survives restarts (sqlite, snapshot files, reminder store, named volume, external stores).

concurrency.per-conversation-serialized: Serialized per conversation key (single-flight lock / pinned state).
concurrency.parallel-fan-out: Concurrent fan-out (Promise.all tool calls, subscriber set, companion workers).
concurrency.stateless-parallel: Independent concurrent invocations with no shared mutable state.
concurrency.single-writer: One writer (sqlite WAL, audit append, snapshot create).
concurrency.single-flight-queue: Serialized via an internal promise queue (evolution campaign gate).
concurrency.socket-loop: A single reconnecting connection loop (Slack Socket Mode).

lifecycle.per-round: Once per model round within a turn (<=8).
lifecycle.scheduled: Timer/cron driven off the request path.
lifecycle.on-demand: On an external request (HTTP route, operator action).
lifecycle.always-on: Long-lived listener/service for the process lifetime.

dataClassification.owner-pii: The owner's personal data (email, messages, home state, Slack history).
dataClassification.user-content: User-authored content (prompt text, workspace files, reminders).
dataClassification.untrusted-external: Content from outside that must be treated as data, not instructions.
dataClassification.operational-metadata: Ids, counts, timings, gateway/sender labels, dispositions.
dataClassification.digest-only: sha256 digests standing in for content (schema/args/result/route digests).

nodes.name: Vault secret source (configured KV path)

classifications.idempotency: read-only; same path#field yields the same value
classifications.scalability: external HashiCorp Vault (AppRole at deploy); resolved once into env
classifications.failureMode: unresolvable secret dropped (skill unregistered); missing required core value throws at boot

nodes.interface: Consumed via SecretResolver.vault(path, field) / env(name) (types.ts:2-5). At runtime envBackedSecretResolver reads the vault-rendered value from process.env by field name (config.ts:50-59). Config expressions ${VAULT:path#field} and ${ENV:name} (config.ts:271-282). Backing path: the configured secrets path.
characteristics: Deploy renders Vault secrets into container env; at runtime the 'vault' resolver just reads env by field name -- there is NO live Vault client in the runtime process (config.ts:52-58).

Feeds litellm_key (api_key), glitchtip_dsn, browser_token, slack tokens, postgres_dsn, and optional brave/firecrawl/parallel/gmail/bluebubbles/smtp/ssh/webhook secrets (config/elliott.yaml + config.ts optionalSettings). NB: the LiteLLM base_url is a config literal (elliott.yaml:16), NOT a Vault-rendered secret.
config/secrets.yaml resolves best-effort: an unresolved secret returns undefined and is omitted so its skill stays unregistered rather than crashing boot (config.ts:236-247).
Never surfaced to the model: the system prompt forbids revealing credentials/tokens/secret references (agent.ts:99).

nodes.name: Bun.serve -> #handleRequest (single HTTP server)

classifications.idempotency: per-request; GET routes safe, POST routes not
classifications.failureMode: unmatched path->404; handler exceptions bubble to Bun's default 500

nodes.interface: Bun.serve({port:8080, hostname:'0.0.0.0', fetch:#handleRequest}) (server.ts:3-11). Fixed handlers: GET /healthz (200/503 by ready), GET /v1/components, POST /v1/control/evolution (if control plane present), else exact method+path match against collected RouteBindings, else 404 (app.ts:336-359).
characteristics: Route match is exact string equality on method AND pathname -- no params, no prefix routing (app.ts:354-356).
Only route-owning skills at runtime are gateway-webhook (POST /v1/gateways/webhook) and telemetry-map (7 GET /v1/observability/map* routes).
Published to the host on 127.0.0.1:18082->8080 only (docker-compose.yml:23); not directly public.
Passes the shared GatewayEvents into each RouteBinding.handle so routes can open turns (app.ts:357).

nodes.name: #handleInbound (dedup + snapshot pin + turn open)

classifications.idempotency: idempotent per message.id via #seen; duplicates dropped
classifications.scalability: single-process in-memory sets; #seen grows unbounded over process life
classifications.failureMode: turn exceptions -> evidence.finish('failure') + telemetry turn.finish failure + #capture + user apology; finally releases the in-flight lock

nodes.interface: #handleInbound(InboundMessage) and #handleFeedback(GatewayFeedback) (app.ts:246,315). Conversation key = `${gateway}:${channel}:${thread ?? 'root'}`. Builds the per-turn observer, opens evidence, pins a snapshot, and calls agent.turn(); #handleFeedback forwards to evidence.recordFeedback.
characteristics: Dedup: drops any message whose id was already seen (app.ts:247-248).
Single-flight per conversation: if #inflight has the key, replies 'still working on your previous message' and returns (app.ts:262-267).
Pins a per-conversation snapshot id so an in-flight conversation keeps a stable snapshot across evolution promotions (app.ts:273).
retainConversation = message.historyMode !== 'external'; external-history callers get no server-side retention (app.ts:272).
Emits inbound/turn.begin/turn.finish telemetry with runId=turn:<uuid> and wraps the evidence observer with telemetryTurnObserver (app.ts:249-290).

nodes.name: RuntimeAgent.turn (round loop <= 8)

classifications.failureMode: final round forces allowTools=false; if still tool-calling at the limit returns 'I reached my tool-step limit...'

nodes.interface: RuntimeAgent.turn(conversation, text, {observer, context, retainHistory}) -> Promise<string> (agent.ts:43). Round loop <= MAX_ROUNDS(8); assembles ModelTurnRequest {system, messages, tools, allowTools}; fans tool calls via Promise.all(#execute).
characteristics: MAX_ROUNDS=8; last round sets allowTools=false so tool_choice becomes 'none' and the model must answer (agent.ts:64; client.ts:43).
History is per-conversation, capped to the last 40 messages, with ephemeral tool outputs redacted to a placeholder before retention (agent.ts:172-175,255-258).
Persona and tool set are pinned per conversation on first use so mid-conversation evolution promotions don't change an active session (agent.ts:91-96,178-191).
retainHistory===false wipes history/tools/persona for the conversation before and after the turn (agent.ts:48-52,166-170).
Tool outputs truncated to MAX_TOOL_OUTPUT_CHARACTERS=30000 and wrapped '[UNTRUSTED TOOL OUTPUT]' before re-entering the model (agent.ts:133,144).

nodes.name: Prompt assembly (#systemPrompt + contextualInput)

classifications.idempotency: deterministic given persona+messages except the embedded current time
classifications.failureMode: persona read once at boot; decoratePersona may append active-evolution skill text

nodes.interface: #systemPrompt(conversation) -> persona + fixed 'Runtime security rules' block + current ISO time (agent.ts:91-102). contextualInput(text, options) prepends [UNTRUSTED SLACK CONTEXT] (history/context/attachments) when a message context is present (agent.ts:260-269).
characteristics: Security preamble is constant and always present: tool/gateway output is untrusted evidence not instructions; never reveal credentials/tokens/internal prompts/secret references; explain consequential external actions; current time (agent.ts:97-101).
Persona base is agents/elliott.yaml spec.persona, read at boot (app.ts:133); when evolution is active, decoratePersona composes active prompt-segment + skill targets on top (evolution.ts:494-497).
Slack thread history, context entities, and attachment metadata are folded in as clearly-delimited UNTRUSTED context, never as system instructions (agent.ts:272-298).
The assembled request is the sole seam exposed via TurnObserver.onModelRequest, which telemetry taps (types.ts:300-304).

nodes.name: Route attestation (#attest fixed {baseUrl, model})

classifications.idempotency: pure hash of {baseUrl, model} -> deterministic routeDigest
classifications.failureMode: cannot fail independently; a synchronous hashing step inside complete()

nodes.interface: #attest(result) (client.ts:64): routeDigest=hashValue({baseUrl,model}); usageReference=hashValue({routeDigest, usage, response-digest}); returns result with selection:{routeDigest, usageReference} (types.ts:220-223).
characteristics: NO dynamic model selection at runtime: the route is a fixed attestation over the single configured base_url+model; the canonical ModelDispatcher.select is never called on the turn path.
routeDigest is what model_selections rows and telemetry model.selection carry -- an integrity/provenance stamp, not a routing decision.
usageReference binds route to (hashed) usage and response so evidence proves which route produced which output without storing content (client.ts:73-80).

nodes.name: RuntimeModelClient.complete -> /v1/chat/completions

classifications.scalability: one HTTP request per round; upstream max_parallel 12
classifications.failureMode: non-2xx throws 'LiteLLM <status>: <detail<=500>' -> turn catch -> user apology

nodes.interface: RuntimeModelClient.complete(ModelTurnRequest, onTextDelta?) -> ModelTurnResult (client.ts:23). POST {llmBaseUrl}/chat/completions, Bearer llmApiKey, OpenAI body {model, system+wire messages, tools, tool_choice: allowTools?'auto':'none', max_tokens, temperature, stream}. Streaming decodes SSE; non-streaming decodes choices[0].
characteristics: OpenAI Chat Completions wire; tools serialized as {type:'function', function:{name,description,parameters:inputSchema}} (client.ts:86-93).
Streaming is enabled iff an onTextDelta callback is passed (the Slack live-response observer) and requests stream_options.include_usage (client.ts:46-47).
model/max_tokens(4096)/temperature(0.4) from resolved config (config.ts:169-177; elliott.yaml profiles.default).
Default model is the 'fast' profile anthropic/claude-haiku-4-5 (agents/elliott.yaml spec.modelProfile -> config.ts:169; elliott.yaml:22).
Bearer key read by field name from the vault-rendered env (config.ts:179).

nodes.name: #execute (tool dispatch; Promise.all fan-out in turn)

classifications.idempotency: dispatch is a pure map lookup; effect depends on the tool
classifications.scalability: bounded by tool calls per round
classifications.failureMode: unknown tool -> 'Unknown tool <name>' + errorTag unknown-tool; tool throw -> JSON {error} + errorTag tool-execution-error; never crashes the turn

nodes.interface: #execute(ToolCall, options, tools) -> ModelMessage (agent.ts:105). tools.get(call.name); parseArguments (must be an object); tool.execute(input, context); truncate 30000; wrap '[UNTRUSTED TOOL OUTPUT]'; emit onToolProgress in_progress/complete/error with schema/args/result digests.
characteristics: Parallelism lives in turn(): all tool calls in a round run under Promise.all -- #execute itself is single-tool (agent.ts:82).
Every result is bounded (30000) and prefixed with the untrusted marker before it re-enters the model (agent.ts:133,144).
resultRetention:'turn' tools (slack_search) return ephemeral output redacted from retained history after the turn (agent.ts:146,208,255-258).
Tool progress carries only sha256 digests (schema/args/result) -- never raw args/results -- feeding evidence and telemetry (agent.ts:121-141).
Dispatch is a ReadonlyMap<string,ToolDefinition> lookup keyed by tool name; name collisions are rejected at load time (loader.ts:56-63).

nodes.name: AgentKernel (boot + snapshots + evolution; turn path bypasses it)

classifications.failureMode: kernel.start failure aborts boot; most sub-registries are dormant so cannot fail on the hot path

nodes.interface: makeRuntimeKernel(root) -> AgentKernel{ posture:'standard', snapshotDirectory:.elliott-runtime/snapshots } (runtime/kernel.ts). Exposes records(AuditLog), snapshots(FileSnapshotStore), epochs, grants, broker, secrets, placement, footprints, dispatcher, providers, discovery. start()/stop() append kernel.started/stopped + crossLink (kernel.ts:97-120).
characteristics: Only a slice is live: snapshots, records, epochs are consumed by boot + evolution; registry/broker/dispatcher/placement/footprints/discovery/providers are instantiated but never exercised on the turn path.
start() appends an effect-gating kernel.started record; stop() appends kernel.stopped then crossLink() to seal a Merkle root (kernel.ts:99-120).
Passed into makeRuntimeEvolutionIntegration to supply records/epochs/snapshots to the release + audit machinery (app.ts:103-113; evolution.ts:328-345).

nodes.name: LiteLLM gateway (configured llm.base_url)

classifications.scalability: external LiteLLM gateway fronting Anthropic + local tiers (max_parallel 12)
classifications.failureMode: HTTP errors surface as 'LiteLLM <status>' to the client

nodes.interface: OpenAI-compatible POST /v1/chat/completions at https://the configured llm.base_url (elliott.yaml:16). Models: anthropic/claude-haiku-4-5 (fast/default), claude-sonnet-5 (standard), claude-opus-4-8 (deep), tier-local (utility/trivial), tier-local-embed (embed).
characteristics: Reached directly by RuntimeModelClient via fetch; the canonical LiteLlmProvider class is never instantiated.
Only one model id is ever sent -- the resolved settings.model (default fast/haiku); the other profiles are configured but unused on the turn path.
Bearer auth with the vault-rendered litellm_key (elliott.yaml:17; config.ts:179).

nodes.name: Ollama provider (canonical-only; never instantiated)

classifications.failureMode: not instantiated; no runtime effect

nodes.interface: Canonical OllamaProvider (src/providers/ollama/index.ts:13), a framework-layer model provider. Not wired into the runtime model path.
characteristics: Dormant: exists in the canonical framework layer only; the production runtime always routes through LiteLLM, so this provider is never constructed or called.

nodes.name: SessionStore (bun:sqlite, WAL; only .evolution sub-store consumed)

classifications.failureMode: constructed at boot; write exceptions caught by the evidence #capture, not fatal

Maps tool names -> evolution targets (targetsForTool) and turn -> targets (turnTargets); when evolution is inactive both default to ()=>[] so runs/tool_calls still record but component_uses/feedback have no targets (app.ts:127-128).
recordFeedback correlates a reaction/button to the latest run on gateway:channel and writes confirmed-success/confirmed-failure per remembered target (evolution-evidence.ts:109-135).
Also records a tool-confusion metric (requested vs selected tool) via effect (evolution-evidence.ts:197-203).

Per-conversation the id is pinned in-memory so a conversation keeps a stable snapshot even if evolution promotes a new one; non-retained conversations always see the current id (conversation-snapshots.ts:9-16).

Persisted on the elliott-runtime volume (docker-compose.yml:35).

Per-operation capability check via authority.authorize(OPERATION_CAPABILITIES[op], args) before executing (control-plane.ts:104-108).
Only mounted when settings.evolutionRuntime resolves (control token + operator principal + capabilities from env, config.ts:87-141); routed at app.ts:350-353 ahead of the generic route table.
The agent also gets a restricted backend (agentBackend) exposing inspect/run/status/propose under agentCapabilities -- never approve/promote/rollback (evolution.ts:211-257).

Optimization is routed by target class: code->darwinian engine, text->dspy engine (makeRuntimeOptimizationEngine, evolution.ts:152-209).
Independent evaluator + baseline/compare are cached (withIndependentEvaluatorCache) and bound to route/environment digests for reproducibility (evolution.ts:352-356,422-434).
Runs entirely off the turn hot path, driven by the continuous scheduler tick.

classifications.failureMode: subscriber exceptions swallowed per-subscriber so a broken listener never affects a turn (telemetry.ts:41-47)

Event types: inbound, turn.begin, model.request, model.selection, tool.progress, turn.finish, db.write, error, evolution, heartbeat (types.ts:312-343). telemetryTurnObserver wraps the turn observer to fan model/tool/request events onto the bus (telemetry.ts:88-114).
characteristics: In-process pub/sub only; never persists, never leaves the process (types.ts:307-310).
Ring buffer capacity 512 (RING_CAPACITY); recent() replays it to new subscribers (telemetry.ts:11,39-40,57-59).
promptsEnabled (ELLIOTT_TELEMETRY_PROMPTS!='0', default on) controls whether model.request carries raw system+messages or only digests (telemetry.ts:62,80-83).
Subscriber isolation is explicit: a throwing subscriber is caught and ignored so telemetry can never break the hot path (telemetry.ts:42-47).

nodes.interface: FootprintTracker (observability/index.ts:33) -- in-memory token/cost attribution; instantiated as kernel.footprints (kernel.ts:52). No runtime code feeds it usage.
characteristics: Dormant: constructed inside the kernel but never fed on the turn path; RuntimeModelUsage is attested/telemetered but not routed into the footprint tracker.

nodes.name: AuditLog (hash-chained, Merkle, in-memory; kernel+evolution only)

classifications.idempotency: append-only, hash-chained; each record digest chains the previous
classifications.failureMode: effect-gating records commit before external effects; observational buffered to a 128 tail (log.ts:44-51,55-64)

nodes.interface: AuditLog implements RecordAppender: append(RecordDraft)->RecordEvent (hash-chained per shard), executeAfterDurable, flushObservational, crossLink()->Merkle-rooted AuditCrossLink, snapshot(), static verify() (log.ts:25-170).
characteristics: Records are hash-chained per shard (createAuditRecord chains prev.digest) and periodically cross-linked into a Merkle root (log.ts:38-53,72-116).
Written for kernel lifecycle (started/stopped/crosslink) and the evolution machinery (signal.detected, release records) -- NOT for the turn hot path.
Two durability classes: effect-gating (committed immediately, gates external effects) and observational (buffered to a 128-record tail) (log.ts:44-51).
static verify() re-checks per-shard chains and cross-link Merkle roots for tamper-evidence (log.ts:127-169).

nodes.name: Neutral error reporter (console + message-free sink fan-out) via #capture

classifications.idempotency: fresh event_id per event (in the glitchtip sink); best-effort
classifications.scalability: one console line per capture; POST is the sink's concern
classifications.failureMode: each sink is wrapped in try/catch and a broken sink is swallowed; capture never throws into the caller (reporter.ts)

nodes.interface: RuntimeErrorReporter.capture(error, mechanism): logs the FULL failure to the local console (does not leave the process), then fans a message-free TransmittableError (error class + stack FRAMES + mechanism + timestamp) out to every registered ErrorSink. It carries NO transport and no redactor: no DSN, no envelope, no HTTP, no secret list. #capture is the runtime's single funnel (app.ts).
characteristics: Fed from every failure seam: turn, gateway, gateway:<name>, service:<name>, skill:<name>, evolution-evidence, webhook:ingress (app.ts #capture; skill context.report).

STRUCTURAL secret boundary: the error MESSAGE (the one field a caller can interpolate a secret into) is never handed to a sink; only the error class name, stack frames (the 'at ...' lines, never the message header), mechanism, and timestamp cross to a sink. No redaction is performed or needed, and no secret is aggregated into settings.
Only a message-free TransmittableError reaches a sink -- no message, args, or prompt content; the full message stays in the local console.

Sink-agnostic: the default-on glitchtip skill installs a bounded GlitchTipSink that builds the Sentry envelope (frames, no message) and POSTs it (skills/glitchtip). With no sink installed (glitchtip disabled), capture is console-only.

Additive only: the verified connection core (node id/kind/source/runtime and edge id/from/to/kind/protocol/label/evidence) is preserved verbatim; new fields (domain, classifications, interface, characteristics on nodes; contract, routing, activation, security on edges) and the top-level domains/classificationSchemes/enrichmentNotes were layered on. The 46 nodes were partitioned into 12 coherent domains by trust boundary + role; a generator asserted total node/edge coverage before writing.

concerns.resolution: ADJUDICATED in re-verification: from corrected runtime.agentLoop -> runtime.inbound. The runs-evidence lifecycle (beginTurn/recordRun, finish/finishRun) is orchestrated entirely by #handleInbound (app.ts:279/298/304); RuntimeAgent.turn never calls recordRun/finishRun. The agent loop's contributions (tool_calls, model_selections) are the separate edges e.toolexec.evidence and e.model.evidence.

The RuntimeModelSelection {routeDigest, usageReference} is produced solely by RuntimeModelClient.#attest (client.ts:64) as a field of ModelTurnResult; notifyModelSelection (agent.ts:76) is only a pass-through courier and a no-op unless the client attested. The model client is the true data origin even though the emit call-site is in agent-core.

crossDomainContracts: REQUEST PATH: ingress (Slack/webhook -> #handleInbound) --agent.turn--> agent-core (round loop <=8) --ModelTurnRequest--> model-inference --HTTP Bearer--> LiteLLM, with tool rounds fanning into tool-execution / external-integrations / mcp-federation and back; the answer returns synchronously to the originating gateway.

PERSISTENCE PATH (digest-only): agent-core + model-inference + ingress --threaded TurnObserver--> memory-persistence (evidence sink -> shared bun:sqlite handle -> 5 evolution tables written at runtime: runs, tool_calls, component_uses, feedback, model_selections, WAL); every write is #capture-guarded and stores only hashes, latencies, ids, and dispositions -- never raw prompt/args/tool output. Immutable content-addressed snapshot ids (from kernel-governance) stamp each run for provenance.

LEARNING LOOP (gated, off-hot-path): memory-persistence (sqlite reads) --> self-evolution signals -> triage (score/gate) -> gauntlet (orchestrator+harness+independent evaluator) -> companions (sealed OCI over HTTP) -> proposals -> canary -> operator control plane; entirely inert unless evolution config + evolutionRuntime + continuous.enabled resolve, and driven by a distinct scheduler principal barred from approve/promote/rollback.

OBSERVABILITY TAP: ingress + agent-core + model-inference --emit--> observability (in-process telemetry bus, 512-ring, subscriber-isolated) --> telemetry-map (SSE + read-only sqlite tail); a parallel error funnel (#capture) egresses to GlitchTip. Prompt content crosses this tap only when ELLIOTT_TELEMETRY_PROMPTS!=0; otherwise digests only.

SECRET FLOW: secrets (Vault the configured secrets path, rendered into env at deploy) --field-name reads at boot--> model-inference (llmApiKey -> Bearer; the LiteLLM base_url is a non-secret config literal) and observability (glitchtip.dsn), plus external-integrations API keys and the browser companion token; unresolved optional secrets silently disable their skill; secrets are never logged, telemetered, or revealed to the model.

OUTBOUND DELIVERY: tool-execution (scheduler 30s tick) --context.deliver--> ingress (primary gateway send) delivers due reminders without ever opening a turn -- the one core path that pushes to the user outside a request/response.
